query: Were Thomas H. Ince and Joseph McGrath of the same nationality?

pipeline_result.response: No, they are not of the same nationality.
retrieved_context: Thomas H. Ince: Thomas Harper Ince (November 16, 1880 – November 19, 1924) was an American silent film producer, director, screenwriter, and actor.

Joseph McGrath (film director): Joseph McGrath (born 1930, Glasgow) is a Scottish film and television director and screenwriter.  He studied at Glasgow School of Art in the late 1940s/early 1950s where his energy and talent was much admired by his contemporaries.
